title: MemStack LongMemEval-S retrieval evidence
description: Public LongMemEval-S cleaned benchmark pack for measuring retrieval-only evidence-session recall with MemStack's local lexical retriever. This does not measure answer quality.

license.name: MIT License
license.attribution: LongMemEval authors: Di Wu, Hongwei Wang, Wenhao Yu, Yuwei Zhang, Kai-Wei Chang, and Dong Yu. LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory, ICLR 2025. Dataset mirror: xiaowu0162/longmemeval-cleaned.
license.useNotes: The upstream dataset card identifies this cleaned dataset as MIT. The data is public, not hidden or access-controlled. MemStack does not redistribute or vendor the dataset; users fetch the pinned upstream file through Val. Preserve the upstream attribution when using the data.

source.task: Retrieval-only evidence-session recall at explicit K; no answer generation or judge
contaminationNotes: This is a publicly available evaluation dataset and must not be described as hidden or contamination-resistant.
Retrieval evidence-session recall is not LongMemEval's official end-to-end question-answering accuracy and is not directly comparable to its QA leaderboard.
